hook: Sit Patrick Mahomes? Three start-sit coin flips. Same projections. We broke every tie.
d1: Same game, two running backs. James Cook is averaging twenty-two point six. Derrick Henry? Ten. Start Cook.
d2: Bryce Young plays tonight, so decide now. Jayden Daniels is averaging twenty-six point six. Young, thirteen point six. Start Daniels.
d3: The big one. Mahomes and Kirk Cousins both project sixteen point eight. Mahomes scored eleven, then seven. Cousins hasn't dropped below thirteen. Sit Mahomes.
cta: Get start-sit calls for your own league in War Room. Link in bio.
